verdict.rationale: The evidence shows integration guides, test data, a sandbox-testing page and an llms.txt markdown index, but nothing documents an interactive API reference or runnable "try it" examples. The OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on every candidate path. llms.txt and markdown docs are a different capability (machine-readable docs), so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
